proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: As You Sow on behalf of Elizabeth Kantor Trust U/A DTD 3/11/1993
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how Berkshire intends to measure, disclose and reduce GHG emissions from its underwriting, insuring and investment activities in line with the Paris 1.5°C goal.
proposals.evidence: The Board does not believe issuing a report disclosing how Berkshire intends to measure, disclose and reduce the greenhouse gas emissions associated with its underwriting, insuring and investment activities is necessary.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Michael W. Frerichs as Treasurer for the State of Illinois and Trustee of the Bright Start College Savings Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of GHG emissions by scope and progress toward net-zero goal for Berkshire Hathaway Energy in a consolidated annual report.
proposals.evidence: Berkshire's Board does not believe that additional reporting of Berkshire Hathaway Energy's greenhouse gas emissions by scope and progress toward its net zero decarbonization goal is necessary at this time.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Meredith Benton of Whistle Stop Capital on behalf of Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the effectiveness of Berkshire's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts with quantitative workforce diversity, hiring, promotion and retention metrics by gender, race and ethnicity.
proposals.evidence: Berkshire's Board recommends a "no" vote on this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Segal Marco Advisors on behalf of the AFL-CIO Equity Index Funds
proposals.topic_summary: Urges formation of an independent-director Railroad Safety Committee to review staffing levels and their impact on safety at BNSF and meet with stakeholders on safety issues.
proposals.evidence: The Board does not believe that creating a Railroad Safety Committee of independent directors is necessary or appropriate.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Scott Shepard, Director of the Free Enterprise Project of the National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audited report assessing how the Energy Policy Research Foundation findings would affect Berkshire's financial statement assumptions, valuations and asset estimates.
proposals.evidence: The Board does not believe the issuance of an audited report assessing how applying the findings of the Energy Policy Research Foundation would provide useful information for shareholders.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Paul Chesser on behalf of National Legal and Policy Center
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on the extent to which corporate operations depend on and are vulnerable to China, including reliance on Chinese government-controlled activities.
proposals.evidence: Berkshire discloses material risks to its businesses in its filings with the SEC. In addition, Berkshire's Prohibited Business Practices Policy specifically addresses transactions with China and human rights issues.
